user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a valid category to a task
steps: Select a valid category from the dropdown list.
positive.expected_result: The task is saved with the selected category.

positive.title: Reassign a category to an existing task
steps: Select a different category from the dropdown list.
positive.expected_result: The task is updated with the new category.

negative.title: Attempt to assign an invalid category to a task
steps: Select an invalid category that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the category is invalid.

negative.title: Leave category selection blank
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that category selection is required.

edge.title: Assign a category to a task with maximum character limit
steps: Create a new task named with maximum allowed characters.
Select a valid category from the dropdown list.
edge.expected_result: The task is saved successfully with the selected category.

edge.title: Assign category to task with special characters
steps: Create a new task with special characters in the name.
Select a valid category from the dropdown list.
edge.expected_result: The task is saved successfully with the selected category.
